2609.10922.title: Auto-RecSys: Harnessing Autonomous Research Agents for Industry-Scale Recommender System
2609.10922.paper_summary: Auto-research agents have shown the potential to automate hypothesis generation, experiment execution, and iterative refinement. However, scaling this paradigm to industry-scale recommendation models introduces two challenges: (1) long feedback loops, where model training can take days, making serial iteration prohibitively slow and requiring parallel exploration across multiple research directions; and (2) system complexity, where large configurations, fragile infrastructure dependencies, and multi-day GPU jobs require robust and recoverable execution. We present Auto-RecSys, an autonomous research system for long-horizon experimentation on industry-scale recommendation models. Auto-RecSys addresses these challenges through three harness designs: (1) distributed asynchronous execution for running multiple experiments in parallel across servers, (2) centralized cross-server memory for persistent and recoverable execution across sessions and failures, and (3) cognitive-procedural separation, where natural-language skill files guide LLM reasoning while deterministic scripts enforce operational correctness. Auto-RecSys further employs a dual-loop self-evolving architecture: an Execution Evolution Loop in which model-specific playbooks accumulate operational knowledge by recording failed attempts and crystallizing successful pipelines, and an Idea Evolution Loop in which experimental outcomes inform subsequent ideation. Evaluated on recommendation models, Auto-RecSys significantly reduces the human time required per experiment cycle and improves execution reliability as its playbooks mature.
2609.10922.paper_summary_zh: 自動研究代理已顯示出自動化假設生成、實驗執行和迭代精煉的潛力。<lb/>然而，將這一範式擴展到工業規模的推薦模型會帶來兩個挑戰：（1）長反饋循環，其中模型訓練可能需要數天，這使得串行迭代變得過於緩慢，並需要在多個研究方向上進行並行探索；（2）系統複雜性，大型配置、脆弱的基礎設施依賴性和多天的 GPU 工作需要穩健且可恢復的執行。<lb/>我們提出了 Auto-RecSys，一個針對工業規模推薦模型的長期實驗的自主研究系統。<lb/>Auto-RecSys 通過三種設計來解決這些挑戰：（1）分佈式異步執行，用於在伺服器之間並行運行多個實驗，（2）集中式跨伺服器記憶，用於在會話和故障之間持久且可恢復的執行，以及（3）認知-程序分離，自然語言技能檔案指導 LLM 推理，而確定性腳本則強制操作正確性。<lb/>Auto-RecSys 進一步採用雙循環自我演化架構：執行演化循環，其中特定模型的操作手冊通過記錄失敗嘗試和結晶成功管道來積累操作知識，以及想法演化循環，其中實驗結果為後續創意提供信息。<lb/>在推薦模型上進行評估，Auto-RecSys 顯著減少了每個實驗周期所需的人力時間，並隨著其操作手冊的成熟提高了執行的可靠性。
